profile.name: Gary Josephson
profile.bio: Gary Josephson is an independent candidate for Ohio's 15th Congressional District in 2026. He attended The Ohio State University and was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2022, losing the general election.

platform.point: Says coal is in the past and favors sustainable energy and sustainable agriculture.
Backs green-job creation through public-private partnerships.
Proposes letting borrowers work off student debt through community service.
Wants to remove obstacles that keep people from voting.

welfare.evidence: Has called for universal health care.

liberty.evidence: Supports reproductive rights (abortion) and a right to self-defense while opposing unlimited access to firepower (guns).

energy.evidence: Says coal's time has passed and backs sustainable energy and green jobs.

profile.notes: Platform and scores come from his 2022 campaign as a Democrat, as shown on BallotReady; 2026 statements as an independent could not be verified. His campaign site and Ballotpedia could not be loaded, and social handles are as listed by BallotReady.

profile.name: Tracey Tackett
profile.bio: Tracey Tackett is an independent candidate for Ohio's 4th District and serves as assistant mayor of Springfield, Ohio. Her campaign cites more than 20 years of community service, and she has been endorsed by the Forward Party.

platform.point: Wants to end illegal immigration, reform asylum, offer citizenship to some long-present immigrants and expand high-skilled visas.
Backs an all-of-the-above energy policy favoring the lowest-cost, cleanest sources such as solar and natural gas.
Supports independent redistricting, free photo IDs and ending dark money in campaigns.
Plans to form an independent caucus and lower discharge petition thresholds to break partisan gridlock.
Wants more federal resources and flexibility for local governments, police and firefighters.

immigration.evidence: Calls for ending illegal immigration and border security alongside a pathway to citizenship and more high-skilled immigration.

energy.evidence: Supports an all-of-the-above energy policy prioritizing the cheapest and cleanest options, including solar and natural gas.

profile.name: Michael J. Veloff
profile.bio: Michael J. Veloff won the 2026 Libertarian primary for Ohio's 5th District as a write-in candidate. The United States Pirate Party endorsed him in July 2026.

platform.point: Calls for reform of bail review.
Proposes providing firearms and training to vulnerable people.

profile.notes: Very little public information; platform items come only from a Pirate Party endorsement post, and no campaign website was found.

profile.name: Rocco Bonacci
profile.current_role: Disability advocate; member of the Lawton Access Board
profile.bio: Rocco Bonacci, of Lawton, is a disability advocate and member of the Lawton Access Board. He is a retired U.S. Air Force fighter pilot who commanded Air Force Basic Military Training in San Antonio before settling in Oklahoma.
profile.notes: Background comes from KOSU's candidate list as summarised in search results; no campaign website or policy statements were found.

profile.name: Robert P. Henri
profile.bio: Robert Patrick Henri is an independent candidate for Oklahoma's 5th congressional district. His campaign, Project Due Course, centres on congressional ethics and process reforms.

platform.point: Enact term limits for members of Congress.
Ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks.
Adopt an enforceable Supreme Court ethics code with outside oversight and penalties.
Require a waiting period before votes so bills can be read, longer for bigger bills.
Have independent commissions draw congressional district lines.
Require the Department of Defense to pass a full financial audit.

profile.notes: Listed on the state candidate list as Robert P. Henri; his platform addresses government-ethics reforms that do not map onto the scored domains.
